name: io.github.mailsac/mcp
title: Mailsac
description: Official Mailsac server: test inboxes for AI coding agents to read signup, reset and OTP emails.

environmentVariables.name: MAILSAC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mailsac API key (create one at https://mailsac.com/api-keys; the free plan works)

environmentVariables.name: MAILSAC_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Domain for new test addresses. Defaults to the public mailsac.com; set it to one of your private domains.
